metadata.title: Aura website copy inventory
metadata.extraction_mode: Repository-only; extraction, no copy audit or changes
metadata.language_policy: Preserve every source string verbatim, including English, mistakes, entities, HTML and interpolation expressions; no translation.
metadata.count_definition: One unique ID per source/page/section occurrence or reference-library item. Repeated wording retains separate entries linked through duplicate_of. Counts are not counts of distinct phrases.
metadata.rendering_policy: Expected/conditional refers only to local configuration, never verified live visibility. Unknown Admin values are null with explicit placeholders. Disabled sections and non-live defaults are appendices.
metadata.source_type_note: Preset values use schema default with subtype preset; CSS-generated words use hardcoded Liquid with subtype CSS-generated because requested source enum has no CSS category.
metadata.documentation_policy: AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md and landing-pages.md inspected for implementation context only. No documentation wording is presented as current storefront text; source code/templates win. No local paths are copied.
limitations: No Shopify Admin, live theme, dev server or remote media accessed.
Template assignment, current live configuration, products, policies, menus, media transcripts and third-party injected text are not verifiable from local files.
Liquid expressions, conditional blocks and client-generated copy are recorded with runtime conditions rather than fabricated resolved sentences.
Native browser validation and Shopify-hosted checkout text are external.
French locale selection is assumed only for referenced French translations; all unused locale keys and editor-only labels are excluded from storefront entry counts.
Near-duplicate links are conservative string similarity candidates, not editorial judgments.

J'ai abandonné au bout d'une semaine.

La différence, c'est la pression graduée 18–25 mmHg, vérifiée : plus ferme à la cheville, plus douce vers le mollet, pour vraiment relancer le retour veineux. entries.exact_copy: La plupart des chaussettes écrasent la jambe de façon uniforme. Aura applique une pression graduée — plus ferme à la cheville, plus douce vers le mollet — qui relance le retour veineux et limite l'œdème de fin de garde. Résultat : des chevilles qui ne gonflent plus dans les sabots, du premier patient à la dixième heure.
